payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all divisors of n as product of two dimensions with +2 fix, and for each divisor enumerates factor pairs to compute stolen blocks, keeping the minimum.
payload.rationale: The code performs exhaustive enumeration over factor triples by looping through divisors and their factor pairs, effectively checking all assignments of the +1 role to one factor. No pruning or recursion is used. This is closest to permutation enumeration among given subtypes.
